propositions: max_consecutive_repeat scores cycles with period >= 2 lower than healthy breadth because it only detects adjacent identical signatures, making a genuine 4-cycle invisible (score 1) while a healthy run with diverse calls scores higher (score 5)

a windowed distinct-ratio metric (set cardinality of trailing 24 signatures divided by 24, ≤ 0.50 threshold) correctly discriminates genuine loops from healthy sequences across measured traces and is order-insensitive
_repetition_summary must emit distinct_ratio_window as None when fewer than REPETITION_WINDOW signatures exist to prevent false positives on short all-identical prefixes

the new signal is additive to existing counters; the producer, consumer actuators, and recorder must share module-level constants REPETITION_WINDOW=24 and REPETITION_TRIP_RATIO=0.50 to enforce one definition

module reorganization split usage_log.py (kept at 572 LOC with schema and write path) from new usage_report.py (313 LOC with read/price/summarize/CLI) using lazy __getattr__ forwarding to preserve CLI contract and test compatibility
